retail_blocker.observed_frame: The 14-draw transition batch failed closed before a live video frame was shown.

retail_blocker.intermediate_copies: The same batch contains seven distinct format-31 destinations before the final presenter copy.
retail_blocker.causality: The unsupported frame failure and the static disclaimer are temporally related; the capture does not prove that this failure prevents video startup.

changes.copy_source_contract: Each captured Copy/Convert operation now retains raw source surface_info, color_info, depth_info, and mode_control alongside its destination state and source extent. Diagnostics therefore expose the mode-6 EDRAM source layout needed by a future ordered-copy executor.
changes.interrupt_trace: With SHIFT_NATIVE_VULKAN_TRACE_RING=1, the first 128 PM4_INTERRUPT packets log source=1, ring generation, batch read/write pointers, ring address, expanded packet ordinal, source IB and byte offset, requested CPU mask, and CPUs whose callbacks were dispatched.

interrupt_audit.dispatch_contract: The P2 expanded-packet loop handles each opcode-0x54 PM4_INTERRUPT once, decodes its CPU mask, and calls ExecuteInterrupt(source=1) once for each asserted CPU bit from 0 through 5. DispatchGuestInterrupt has no retry or coalescing state.
interrupt_audit.historical_p2_capture: An older live run records two PM4_INTERRUPT packets and two guest callbacks across two separate ring batches; it is not the same watchpoint capture described by Process 1.
interrupt_audit.p1_watchpoint_attribution: Not established: packet identities and CPU masks for the two callback stack entries are not present in the supplied observation. The new trace distinguishes separate packets, a multi-bit mask, and repeated packet publication in a future run.

regressions.renderer: Draw -> format-31 Copy/Convert -> Draw preserves raw mode-6 source registers in diagnostics; reordered draw references remain rejected.
regressions.live_ring: Three successive fixture batches each preserve one PM4_INTERRUPT with cpu_mask=0x04; the callback mask is zero because the smoke fixture does not register a guest callback.

rexglue_linux_plugin.note: An initial full-suite run had transient SIGBUS failures in live-ring integration checks; the checks passed on an isolated run and the complete serial rerun passed 7/7.

redmi_note_8_pro.visible_screen: Static English safety disclaimer; no input was sent and the game was left running.
